ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  63 moons technologies limited announced its subsidiary, Ticker Limited, invested Rs. 89 lakhs cash into Quantblock Technovation Private Limited, a wholly-owned step-down subsidiary, to fund its working capital needs. This investment comes as Quantblock, an IT solutions provider incorporated in May 2025, reported zero turnover and a significant loss of Rs. 548.32 lakhs for the fiscal year ending March 2026. The substantial losses and lack of revenue in this newly formed entity indicate a high-risk venture requiring continued financial support from the parent company group, which could be a material drag on resources.
